notes: Fixed the Deny Song dialog sending the denial as soon as you pressed Enter in the custom message box. Enter now starts a new line, and the denial is sent only when you click Deny.
mac_notes: Fixed the Deny Song dialog sending the denial as soon as you pressed Enter in the custom message box. Enter now starts a new line, and the denial is sent only when you click Deny.
windows_notes: You can now delete your own admin notes, after a confirmation. Notes typed in the web admin are no longer re-credited to whoever adds the next note. Documents on File now open a preview when clicked, and downloads keep their real file name instead of "download".
